svg.title: Shared baselines along a backward token-level signal path
svg.desc: Two successful rollouts each have reward one. Subtracting the same terminal baseline, .5, gives .5. Multiplying by final-token ratios 2 and .2 gives incoming values 1.0 and .1. Subtracting the same baseline .2 at the previous position gives advantages positive .8 and negative .1. A further ratio multiplication and baseline subtraction continue at token L minus 2. Every multiplication and subtraction has the same circular operation symbol. Shared baselines connect to both rollout rows. The illustrative baselines are not estimated from the displayed samples.
